headline: Gap Cuts Full-Year Outlook as Unseasonably Warm Weather Hurts Sales
summary: Specialty retailer Gap Inc. lowered its full-year financial guidance as unseasonably warm weather slowed consumer demand for fall and holiday clothing lines at its Old Navy chain.
why: Gap Inc. is an established U.S. apparel retailer operating global store chains including Old Navy, Banana Republic, and Gap.

impacts.name: Gap
impacts.why: Lowered financial sales projections due to weak seasonal demand weigh on investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Management's decision to trim full-year sales guidance triggered investor selling in the retail stock.
